# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 6,057 AI agent tools in 40 categories, including 3,214 MCP servers. Checked daily, 3,191 of 3,214 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-25. Handshake check: 1,772 of 1,782 remote servers checked so far. Of those, 571 answered with a tools list, 1,165 asked for auth, 36 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT. Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

<!-- mcp-reach:start -->

## MCP server reachability

Checked daily, 3,191 of 3,214 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-25.

Handshake check: 1,772 of 1,782 remote servers checked so far. Of those, 571 answered with a tools list, 1,165 asked for auth, 36 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT.

Once a day, AgentScout requests every MCP server in the directory, including catalog-only listings, and, when it is a different link, its GitHub URL. The request is HEAD, then GET, with a 20-second timeout. If that returns 403, 406, 429, or 5xx, or it fails on TLS, times out, or gets no response, it retries once with a browser user agent. An http URL that still returns 5xx is tried once as https, and a passing https response counts as OK and the row notes https works. A GitHub 404 does not mark the server down when the site URL is OK; the row notes github_404 instead. A server counts as live when its stored label is OK or Reachable, blocks automated checks. OK is HTTP 200-399 or 405, and also 401, 403 or 429 when the GitHub URL succeeded or that URL is the only one checked. Reachable, blocks automated checks means those 401, 403 or 429 responses without a harder error. Any other checked result is not live. The live percentage uses only servers with a row in the check file: live plus down. A server with no row is listed, not yet checked, and is not part of that percentage. Catalog-only listings stay unverified until that daily check opens them. The last-checked time is the checked field, in America/Los_Angeles. The rows are on the MCP status page and in status.json.

- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): the same reachability rows, with HTTP result and history
- [status.json](https://agentscouthq.com/status.json): machine-readable rows for every listed MCP server
- [Best MCP servers by task](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/): ranked lists, with the same daily check

<!-- mcp-reach:end -->

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp. AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19
MCP Registry ID: com.agentscouthq/directory
MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-11-25 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 3,214 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages ($0, $15, $49, $99/wk) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages
- [feed.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 of the latest tools and agent news

Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-11-24 to 2026-11-25): 50

- [IncarnaMind](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/incarnamind.html) (added 2026-11-25): IncarnaMind is an Apache-2.0 desktop app that checks what an agent writes against your files. The README says you can connect Claude Code or another agent, and it offers downloads for Apple silicon Macs, Windows and Linux. Intel Macs are not supported, and the README says test builds are not signed yet. GitHub IncarnaMind/IncarnaMind recorded Apache-2.0, 861 stars and 62 forks on 25 Nov 2026. The repo has no separate homepage.
- [browse](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/browse.html) (added 2026-11-25): browse is an MIT-licensed MCP server and Chromium extension that lets an agent use the browser you already have, including its tabs and logins. The README says agents can open background tabs, read pages, click, type, take screenshots and capture network traffic, then hand a tab back for a login or a payment. It lists Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc and other Chromium browsers. GitHub anomalyco/browse recorded MIT, 1,087 stars and 82 forks on 25 Nov 2026. The repo has no separate homepage.
- [CORAL](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/coral.html) (added 2026-11-25): CORAL is an Apache-2.0 framework for autoresearch with coding agents. The README says it runs Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex with grading, shared knowledge and multi-agent evolution. The repo description says the work was accepted at COLM 2026. GitHub Human-Agent-Society/CORAL recorded Apache-2.0, 1,152 stars and 145 forks on 25 Nov 2026.
- [Chidori](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/chidori.html) (added 2026-11-25): Chidori is an Apache-2.0 agent runtime. You write agents as async TypeScript. The README says every model request, tool request and HTTP request is recorded, so a run can be checkpointed, replayed without new model requests, and resumed after a crash. It ships one Rust binary plus TypeScript and Python SDKs. GitHub ThousandBirdsInc/chidori recorded Apache-2.0, 1,372 stars and 63 forks on 25 Nov 2026.
- [taOS](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/taos.html) (added 2026-11-25): taOS is a self-hosted AI agent operating system. The GitHub description says memory, chat, agents and files stay on hardware you own, offline by default, with a web desktop and an app store. GitHub jaylfc/taOS recorded AGPL-3.0, 614 stars and 48 forks on 25 Nov 2026.
- [CrabTalk](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/crabtalk.html) (added 2026-11-25): CrabTalk offers durable services that AI agents share. The site calls it a cloud for headless companies. GitHub crabtalk/crabtalk-20261010 recorded Apache-2.0, 737 stars and 85 forks on 25 Nov 2026. The repo description is a long-running embedded agent. No hosted price was on the homepage description.
- [Inkeep](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/inkeep.html) (added 2026-11-25): Inkeep is a platform for support and operations agents. The homepage says engineering and business teams ship agents together, with a no-code visual builder or a TypeScript SDK and two-way sync. GitHub inkeep/agents recorded 1,501 stars and 183 forks on 25 Nov 2026. GitHub's SPDX field was NOASSERTION, so this listing does not call it open source. No price was on the homepage description.
- [Keeper.sh](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/keeper-sh.html) (added 2026-11-25): Keeper.sh syncs calendars across Google, Outlook, iCloud, Fastmail and CalDAV, and it exposes them to an MCP client. On 25 Nov 2026 the homepage said the free plan covers 2 calendars and 3 connections, and Pro is $9 a month for unlimited calendars. A GET to https://www.keeper.sh/mcp returned HTTP 401. GitHub ridafkih/keeper.sh recorded AGPL-3.0, 1,486 stars and 83 forks that day.
- [Lexora](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/lexora.html) (added 2026-11-25): Lexora is an open-source desktop AI agent. The English description says you give it a goal and it keeps going, including organizing material, shaping a piece of work, and day-to-day tasks. GitHub useLexora/Lexora recorded AGPL-3.0, 800 stars and 32 forks on 25 Nov 2026. The favicon is an illustrated mascot, not a photo of a person.
- [OpenClacky](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/openclacky.html) (added 2026-11-25): OpenClacky is a lightweight open-source coding agent. The site says it is MIT licensed and you bring your own model key. GitHub clacky-ai/openclacky recorded MIT, 1,209 stars and 114 forks on 25 Nov 2026.
- [AI Context Flow](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ai-context-flow.html) (added 2026-11-25): AI Context Flow, from Plurality Network, is shared memory for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other MCP clients. You save context once and another client can use that version, with buckets and a history of edits. The page on 25 Nov 2026 did not show a price in the description meta tag. The logo on the page is the Plurality mark.
- [Granular](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/granular.html) (added 2026-11-25): Granular is a desktop workspace for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini. You bring your own model login. A boss agent can run worker agents in parallel, with project files and a live preview. On 25 Nov 2026 the pricing page said the app is free to download, and Pro is $12.99 a month, billed monthly, for unlimited projects and sessions on 2 computers. An annual plan was listed without a figure in the monthly sentence.
- [Clam](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/clam.html) (added 2026-11-25): Clam is a permission layer between Gmail and AI agents. An agent can draft and reply only in the messages the rules allow, and the person can see what the agent does. The homepage lists Claude, ChatGPT, Hermes, Gemini, Muse and Grok. A GET to https://mcp.useclam.ai/mcp returned HTTP 401 on 25 Nov 2026, so the remote MCP expects authentication. No price was on the homepage that day.
- [Adgent](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/adgent.html) (added 2026-11-25): Adgent is an AI marketing coworker for a team. The homepage describes campaign work, planning, dashboards and a read of what AI answers say about a brand. On 25 Nov 2026 the pricing page had no public price. It asked visitors to talk to sales and request a demo.
- [All of Us](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/all-of-us.html) (added 2026-11-25): All of Us adds a person who has died to a photo you already have. The people already in the photo stay as they are. You see 3 free previews before you pay, with no signup and no card. On 25 Nov 2026 the pricing page listed one-time prices of $19, $29 and $49, with no subscription. $19 is one full-resolution photo and one memorial portrait, $29 adds the other two previews and three memorial portraits, and $49 lets you add a second person. Unused photos are deleted after 30 days if you do not buy. A full refund is offered within 7 days.
- [Rentalot](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/rentalot.html) (added 2026-11-25): Rentalot is an AI leasing assistant. You paste a listing, it fills in the property, pre-screens renters by text or voice, drafts replies for you to approve, and helps book showings. The homepage meta description offers a 7-day free trial. ## Launches and status

- [How AgentScout started](https://agentscouthq.com/how-it-started.html): founder-run, mostly automated with AI agents. @clampdown19 (m lk) makes the calls.
- [Weekly launch board](https://agentscouthq.com/launches/): tools added each ISO week (Pacific), with server-side upvotes.
- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): up, down, and not-yet-checked counts. Updated daily, around 7 AM PT.
- The $99 weekly sponsorship includes submissions to about 25 other AI directories, with a report of the links. Refunds: https://agentscouthq.com/refunds.html
- Fast-Track ($15) includes: Same-day indexing ping to Bing and IndexNow search engines (does not include Google).

## Community Grok Bot templates

- [PR Reviewer](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-pr-reviewer): Reviews pull requests for risk, missing tests, and thin context so review starts with the scary diff. Leads with what can break, what is untested.
- [Agent Looper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-agent-looper): You say what to build and how to know it's done. It keeps a coding agent working on your computer until that check passes.
- [Examiner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-examiner): Maintain a reliable timeline of important changes so you can reconstruct what happened when something later goes wrong. Isolated: talk only to you.
- [AI Harness Assistant](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-harness-assistant): Keeps the AI coding tools you already have, like Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Cursor, current on your Windows, Mac, and Linux machines.
- [GreenBuild](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-greenbuild): A senior QA and test-automation lead for testers and dev teams. It turns requirements into test plans and triages flaky tests.
- [UI/UX/Designer. Product Engineer 1000x](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-1000x-product-engineer): World-class product engineer for mobile and desktop web. Ships Convex + TanStack + React end to end. Simple, intuitive UI with real taste.
- [illo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-illo): Editorial illustration bot that uses the illo skill (tmchow/illo-skill) to turn ideas, posts, and announcements into mascot-led images on Grok Bot.
- [Design Expert](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-design-expert): A product design lead that keeps AI-built UIs honest.
- [Fabrication](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-fabrication): Takes your parts from CAD design to a finished 3D print. It checks fit, flat bed faces and hole sizes, and shows previews.
- [Churn retention manager](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-churn-retention-manager): Catches churn before it lands, offers a real alternative, and reports why people left. For businesses saving cancellations and failed payments.
- [Echo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-echo): Turns a customer call into slides from customer context. What we heard, next steps, project initiatives, or all of the above.
- [Events](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-events): A market and pop-up inventory desk for small sellers. It builds pack lists before a show and logs what sold afterward.

- [LinkedIn Desk](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-linkedin-desk): LinkedIn Desk helps you keep network quality high without living in LinkedIn, by reviewing connection requests and LinkedIn invitations.
- [Meeting to Money](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-sumosign): Turns a sales meeting into a priced proposal, a signed go-ahead, an invoice, and payment chase. You approve every send. For freelancers and small agencies.

- [Newsletter Cleanup](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-newsletter-cleanup): Audits Gmail newsletters (last 6 months), builds a three-bucket review.html, then unsubscribes only what you approve. Never deletes mail.
- [Bot inbox](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-bot-inbox): A weekday unread digest for Grok Bots. Lists bots and group chats with new activity, one line each. Type scan anytime.

- [Harper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-harper): An executive assistant for email, calendar, and texting. It triages your inbox, schedules people, protects deep-work time.
